extraction.Name: Hattie Whiting Whitcher
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I shoyld rather not have had the patent as the taxes were high and we were living on the place. Under the circumstances I think it only fair that I should be reimbursed for the taxes I had to pay before I sold the land which amounts to about $400.00.
extraction.NOTES: Patent was mailed to her at Spencer, Nebraska; sold land for $6000.00, not all at once (cash consideration); four of her brothers' children depend upon her for support; states she should be reimbursed ~$400.00 for taxes paid before sale; document notarized May 13, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
